property_summary: After a successful call to fallback, if block.number is divisible by 15 the contract's balance must become 0; the buggy version incorrectly makes the balance 0 when block.number is NOT divisible by 15.
change_summary: Change the condition in the if statement from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0, reversing when the balance is transferred.
